categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Wuyang Automation Control Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in intelligent equipment manufacturing and investment operations. Its manufacturing business includes bulk material handling core devices, mechanical parking equipment, automated production line equipment, intelligent logistics and warehousing systems, and mechanized sand equipment. The investment and operation segment focuses on urban parking resource acquisition and parking lot operation management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages mechatronics integration in bulk material handling core devices, including hydraulic tensioning, braking, and feeding systems with advanced technologies such as digital valve-controlled hydraulics and explosion-proof frequency converters. Mechanical parking equipment covers nine types of mechanical parking systems, integrating machinery, electronics, and instrumentation. Automated production lines utilize industrial robots and PLC-based control systems. Intelligent logistics and warehousing systems employ software, IoT, automated sorting, and RFID technologies. The company also develops mechanized sand production lines and dry-mixed mortar plants with automated computer control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span mining, construction, ports, power, cement, manufacturing, steel, real estate, commercial complexes, hospitals, and urban infrastructure sectors. The company serves both public and private sectors, including residential communities, commercial buildings, and government projects. Its parking operation business targets commercial complexes, office buildings, transport hubs, hospitals, and urban roadside parking in major Chinese cities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant revenue from East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast regions. It has invested in parking projects in provinces including Fujian, Liaoning, Yunnan, Jiangxi, and cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Jinan, Kunming, and Chongqing. It also plans to expand internationally into Southeast Asia and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Wuyang operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing specialized equipment and providing integrated solutions. It also engages in downstream investment and operation of parking resources, combining equipment manufacturing with asset management and service operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening technological innovation to lead industry intelligent upgrades, focusing on AI-based mining safety equipment, intelligent charging integrated parking systems, and smart logistics. It emphasizes high-end, intelligent, and green product iterations, talent acquisition and development, digital transformation of management, and expansion of sales networks domestically and internationally. R&D projects include intelligent charging solutions, warehouse automation, vehicle detection and weighing systems, and advanced hydraulic control technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized intelligent manufacturing equipment and installation services, as well as ongoing parking lot operation services. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial services such as leasing. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with customers, with revenue recognized upon delivery and acceptance or over service periods for parking operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's intelligent equipment manufacturing industry, particularly in mechanical parking equipment and bulk material handling. It maintains strong brand recognition through subsidiaries like Weichuang Automation and Tianchen Intelligent. It competes by offering comprehensive product lines, advanced technology, and integrated investment-operation models, distinguishing itself with full mechanical parking equipment manufacturing qualifications and innovative smart parking solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.01 billion, a 25.82% decrease from 2023, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 87.22 million. The company experienced declines in most business segments except for a slight growth in automated production line equipment. Total assets were about RMB 3.19 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 2.32 billion. The company faces short-term performance volatility due to market and industry fluctuations but maintains ongoing operations and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Wuyang emphasizes its core technological advantages in mechatronics integration, intelligent control, and safety features across its product lines. Its mechanical parking equipment is distinguished by comprehensive product types, high safety standards, and integration of intelligent charging facilities. The company offers customized solutions tailored to client needs, supported by professional design, installation, and after-sales services. Its investment-operation synergy and digital management platforms enhance operational efficiency and customer experience, positioning it as a comprehensive smart city infrastructure provider.
